items: Erase everything now clears only this app's data. Your other apps here and your Google Drive backup are left alone, and the prompt says so.
Each session you finish now counts towards the streak on the maker portal.
Easier reading: Atkinson Hyperlegible is the new default font.
Prefer another? Settings → Font offers System, Serif and Monospace, and the choice carries across every app on this site.
Settle in before the bell: an optional countdown of quiet seconds before the sit begins.
Open-ended sits: pick ∞ and the timer counts up until you tap Done, then logs the time you actually sat.
Tap the timer ring to hide the clock and sit without watching the minutes.
Choose a closing bell of one, two or three strikes, and turn on vibration for a silent sit.
A daily reminder you add to your own calendar, and an optional badge on the app icon until today's sit is logged.
Export your history as CSV for a spreadsheet, or share a text summary.
Stats now show your longest sit and your average session.
